plain_text:
U.S. Geological Survey contractor Athina Lange using a black and white
extrinsic calibration target at Marconi Beach, Cape Cod National Seashore,
Massachusetts, on June 12, 2024, to calibrate and validate the geolocation.
The target is one of many used to put the CoastCam—a camera used to
monitor coastal conditions in near realtime—into real-world coordinates.
